shortDescription: Higher oil prices sparked by the West Asia crisis may have lifted the fortunes of ONGC's oil exploration business, but its petrochemical unit is in trouble as feedstock prices go through the roof, a senior official said. Prashant Mukherjee reports.

title: ONGC Petchem Hit by Pricey Feedstock
